# Introduction


```{r stationarity_testing}
library(tseries)

nvda <- original_df
nvda$Date       <- as.Date(nvda$Date)
nvda$log_return <- c(NA, diff(log(nvda$Close)))

# ADF on raw price — expect FAIL (non-stationary)
cat("=== ADF Test: Raw Close Price ===\n")
print(adf.test(nvda$Close))

# ADF on log returns — expect PASS (stationary)
log_ret_clean <- na.omit(nvda$log_return)
cat("\n=== ADF Test: Log Returns ===\n")
print(adf.test(log_ret_clean))
```

```{r structural_break}
library(strucchange)

log_ret_clean <- na.omit(nvda$log_return)
log_ret_ts    <- ts(log_ret_clean)

# CUSUM test
cusum_test <- efp(log_ret_ts ~ 1, type = "OLS-CUSUM")
plot(cusum_test, main = "CUSUM Test — Log Returns")

# Breakpoint test
bp <- breakpoints(log_ret_ts ~ 1)
summary(bp)

# Check if any breakpoints were actually found
if (all(is.na(bp$breakpoints))) {
  cat("\nNo statistically significant structural break found in log returns.\n")
  cat("Interpretation: while price levels clearly shifted regime, daily log returns\n")
  cat("remain statistically stable throughout — consistent with market efficiency.\n")
  cat("Decision: use full dataset for modelling.\n")
  
  break_date <- min(nvda$Date, na.rm = TRUE)  # use full dataset
  
} else {
  break_idx  <- bp$breakpoints[1]
  break_date <- nvda$Date[which(!is.na(nvda$log_return))][break_idx]
  cat("\nDetected structural break date:", as.character(break_date), "\n")
}
```

```{r model_setup}
library(zoo)

# Use only data from the structural break date onward
nvda_post <- nvda[nvda$Date >= break_date, ]

# Features
nvda_post$lag1_return       <- c(NA, head(nvda_post$log_return, -1))
nvda_post$lag2_return       <- c(NA, NA, head(nvda_post$log_return, -2))
nvda_post$lag3_return       <- c(NA, NA, NA, head(nvda_post$log_return, -3))
nvda_post$ma5               <- as.numeric(stats::filter(nvda_post$Close, rep(1/5,  5),  sides = 1))
nvda_post$ma20              <- as.numeric(stats::filter(nvda_post$Close, rep(1/20, 20), sides = 1))
nvda_post$ma_signal         <- as.numeric(nvda_post$ma5 > nvda_post$ma20)
nvda_post$intraday_range_pct <- (nvda_post$High - nvda_post$Low) / nvda_post$Close

# Target: next day's log return
nvda_post$next_return <- c(nvda_post$log_return[-1], NA)

nvda_model <- na.omit(nvda_post[, c("Date", "next_return", "lag1_return",
                                     "lag2_return", "lag3_return",
                                     "ma_signal", "intraday_range_pct")])

cat("Rows after structural break cutoff:", nrow(nvda_model), "\n")
```

```{r rolling_window_model}
window_size <- 126   # ~6 months — shorter window suits the faster-moving regime
n           <- nrow(nvda_model)
preds       <- rep(NA, n)
actuals     <- rep(NA, n)

for (i in (window_size + 1):n) {
  train <- nvda_model[(i - window_size):(i - 1), ]
  test  <- nvda_model[i, ]
  
  model <- lm(next_return ~ lag1_return + lag2_return + lag3_return +
                             ma_signal + intraday_range_pct,
              data = train)
  
  preds[i]   <- predict(model, newdata = test)
  actuals[i] <- test$next_return
}

cat("Rolling window complete.\n")
```

```{r model_evaluation}
valid   <- !is.na(preds)
p       <- preds[valid]
a       <- actuals[valid]

rmse    <- sqrt(mean((p - a)^2))
mae     <- mean(abs(p - a))

# Direction accuracy as a secondary metric
dir_acc <- mean(sign(p) == sign(a))
baseline_dir <- max(mean(a > 0), mean(a < 0))  # always guess majority direction

cat("RMSE:                  ", round(rmse, 6), "\n")
cat("MAE:                   ", round(mae,  6), "\n")
cat("Direction Accuracy:    ", round(dir_acc    * 100, 2), "%\n")
cat("Baseline (majority):   ", round(baseline_dir * 100, 2), "%\n")
```

```{r model_visualisation}
results_df <- data.frame(
  Date      = nvda_model$Date[valid],
  Predicted = p,
  Actual    = a
)

# Predicted vs actual returns
ggplot(results_df, aes(x = Date)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Actual),    color = "#4a90d9", linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Predicted), color = "#76b900", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.9) +
  labs(title    = "Predicted vs Actual Daily Log Returns",
       subtitle = "Green = predicted | Blue = actual",
       x = "Date", y = "Log Return") +
  theme_minimal()

# Rolling direction accuracy
results_df$correct_dir <- as.numeric(sign(p) == sign(a))
results_df$rolling_dir <- zoo::rollmean(results_df$correct_dir, k = 60,
                                         fill = NA, align = "right")

ggplot(results_df, aes(x = Date, y = rolling_dir)) +
  geom_line(color = "#76b900", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = baseline_dir, color = "#e05c5c",
             linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, color = "#4a90d9",
             linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.6) +
  labs(title    = "Rolling 60-Day Direction Accuracy — Linear Regression on Log Returns",
       subtitle = "Red dashed = majority-class baseline | Blue dotted = 50%",
       x = "Date", y = "Direction Accuracy (60-day rolling)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
